# Legal Lounge

> Legal Lounge is an international consultancy firm headquartered in Harare, Zimbabwe. Motto: "Juris Scientia Sine Finibus." (Knowledge of the Law, Without Borders.)

## Areas of practice
- Data Protection: compliance assessments, privacy policies and notices, data processing and data sharing agreements, cross-border transfers and data protection training.
- Company Registrations: registration of companies and other business entities in Zimbabwe and in foreign jurisdictions, with statutory filings and annual returns.
- Tech Law: technology agreements, software and licensing, cyber law, electronic transactions and digital regulatory compliance.
- Risk and Compliance: compliance audits, compliance programmes and internal policies, regulatory monitoring and governance advice.
- Intellectual Property: trade mark registration, copyright and neighbouring rights, licensing arrangements and enforcement of rights.
- Case Law Review: review and analysis of judicial decisions, prepared as written memoranda.
- Legal Research: research on questions of law, presented as research memoranda and legislative analyses.

## Community
- The Forum: networking and professional development for lawyers.
- Mooting: moot court competitions and advocacy training.
- Publishing House: legal scholarship, articles, case notes and practice guides.
